name: PHP
description: PHP via the Sury repository (packages.sury.org), with Composer, common extensions, and opt-in Xdebug / FPM / Symfony CLI / Laravel installer.

version.description: PHP major.minor. Sury publishes 8.1 through 8.5 (and beyond) co-installable.

extensions.default: mbstring intl xml zip gd curl mysql pgsql opcache bcmath gmp
extensions.description: Space-separated extension list. Each becomes `php<version>-<ext>` via apt. Only extensions in `packages.sury.org/php/main` work here. Sodium and pcntl are built into php-cli. For PECL extensions like `redis`, `imagick`, `xdebug`, set `pecl` field. For PHP-level Redis access, prefer the `predis/predis` Composer package — no extension needed.

pecl.description: Space-separated PECL extensions to build from source (e.g. 'redis imagick'). Each is fetched and compiled with phpize; ~30s per extension. Use this when you need a PECL ext that isn't in `packages.sury.org/php/main`.

installComposer.description: Install Composer 2 to /usr/local/bin/composer via the official installer (with hash verification).

installFpm.description: Install php-fpm and configure the default pool to run as the remote user.

installLaravelInstaller.description: Install laravel/installer globally via Composer. Requires installComposer=true.

composerPackages.description: Space-separated extra global Composer packages (e.g. 'phpstan/phpstan friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer').
